observations.measurement_context: Gurley: Gurley was measured by two methods. In the first method defined as the Japanese Industrial Standard Gurley (JIS Gurley), Gurley is measured using the OHKEN permeability tester. JIS Gurley is defined as the time in seconds required for 100 cc of air to pass through one square inch of film at constant pressure of 4.8 inches of H 2 O. In the second method, Gurley is measured according to the ASTM D-726 procedure and is defined as the time in seconds required for 10 cc of air to pass through one square inch of film at constant pressure of 4.8 inches of H 2 O.

In the first method defined as the Japanese Industrial Standard Gurley (JIS Gurley), Gurley is measured using the OHKEN permeability tester. In the second method, Gurley is measured according to the ASTM D-726 procedure and is defined as the time in seconds required for 10 cc of air to pass through one square inch of film at constant pressure of 4.8 inches of H 2 O.
